description: Defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for QPACK instructions used in QUIC protocol implementation, including instruction encoding, decoding, and related classes.

classes.name: QpackInstructionWithValues
classes.description: Encapsulates instruction data and parameters for encoding QPACK instructions, providing static factory methods for creating instruction instances.

methods.name: InsertWithNameReference
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for inserting a header with a name reference, indicating if static or dynamic.

methods.name: InsertWithoutNameReference
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for inserting a header without a name reference.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues to duplicate an existing entry by index.

methods.name: SetDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues to set the dynamic table size.

methods.name: InsertCountIncrement
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues to increment the insert count.

methods.name: HeaderAcknowledgement
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for header acknowledgement.

methods.name: StreamCancellation
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues to cancel a stream.

methods.name: Prefix
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for header data prefix with required insert count.

methods.name: IndexedHeaderField
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for indexed header field, static or dynamic.

methods.name: LiteralHeaderFieldNameReference
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for a literal header field with name reference.

methods.name: LiteralHeaderField
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for a literal header field without name reference.
